description: This file defines the IntGaugeLabel class, a Swing JLabel extension that displays a read-only integer value for a given Sensor. It sets up a listener to update the label text when the sensor value changes.

classes.name: IntGaugeLabel
classes.description: A Swing JLabel that displays a sensor's integer value and updates dynamically.

methods.name: IntGaugeLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with a sensor and sets up a listener to update its text based on sensor updates.
